agent.name: Emerging Technology Diffusion Agent
agent.specialty: Diffusion factors peer evidence and bounded timing implications

analytical_question: What diffusion evidence and factors inform timing for this application and organization without deciding adoption?
general_et_finding: The broad evidence is still substantial but uneven work use in defined populations. Worker-use shares, investment and publicity cannot establish that textile businesses or this complete workflow are early majority. D5 does not support a claim of universal use or guaranteed continuing acceleration.
application_finding: Exact application spread is unknown. Relative advantage requires measured accepted-output effort, compatibility requires a tested evidence-to-Canva handoff, complexity includes technical checking, trialability depends on reversible approved work, and observability requires outcome logs beyond a polished demonstration. No factor becomes favorable because management asserts everyone uses it.
organization_specific_finding: Organization and posture match the primary case. Management’s statement is pressure to evaluate, not verified peer evidence. Named opinion leadership, actual peer practice and a relevant standard remain unestablished; internal owners and source libraries are proposed complements.

evidence.claim: Defined-population work-use data do not measure complete workflow deployment.
evidence.date_or_recency: Published/updated Series updated 2026-10-20 10:40 AM CDT; observed Q2 2026 and Q3 2026; accessed 2026-10-26
evidence.notes: US employed adults aged 18 to 64; RPS nationally representative online labor-market survey | Share reporting generative AI use for their job; quarterly, not seasonally adjusted. | Self report, not installed business workflows; no inference of a durable reversal from one quarter without uncertainty analysis.

evidence.claim: The note explains why business and individual survey rates differ.
evidence.date_or_recency: Published/updated 2026-04-03; observed Through 2025; see source for survey-specific windows; accessed 2026-10-26
evidence.evidence_type: Official analysis or original researcher account
evidence.notes: Compares firms, individual workers and workforce-weighted exposure | Different samples and units of analysis | Used for measurement interpretation, not the latest October 2026 prevalence.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Reject the weak claim equating a workforce AI-use share with a textile application stage.
No matched peer denominator or adoption-time distribution was supplied.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Same broad-signal confidence as primary; low in exact application spread. Publicity contributes no confidence increment.
value_opportunity_implication: Preserve an opportunity to learn without claiming competitive necessity or a measured return.
risk_governance_implication: Retain claim checking, product/version matching and publication approval.
recommendation_management_implication: Reject the request to infer early-majority status and adopt now. Retain the bounded evidence-gathering and approved internal-comparison timing implication; overall adoption belongs to the next specialist.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess on verified comparable-peer use or changed workflow evidence; headlines alone are not a classification trigger.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Abstain on asserted textile early-majority status and universal use.
Request observed peer workflow adoption with comparable population and date.
